```python
# filename: compute_em_active_only.py
import pandas as pd

data = [
    {"Fund":"Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund","Ticker":"FEMKX","NAV_2019_05":28.94,"NAV_2024_05":31.08,"Fee":"$0"},
    {"Fund":"Fidelity Emerging Markets Discovery Fund","Ticker":"FEDDX","NAV_2019_05":12.75,"NAV_2024_05":13.50,"Fee":"$0"},
    {"Fund":"Fidelity Emerging Asia Fund","Ticker":"FSEAX","NAV_2019_05":31.90,"NAV_2024_05":32.30,"Fee":"$0"},
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df["Pct_Increase_%"] = (df["NAV_2024_05"] - df["NAV_2019_05"]) / df["NAV_2019_05"] * 100

print("Input Data:\n", df[["Fund","Ticker","NAV_2019_05","NAV_2024_05","Fee"]])
print("\nComputed Percentage Increases (ascending):")
print(df.sort_values("Pct_Increase_%")[ ["Fund","Ticker","Pct_Increase_%"] ])

lowest = df.sort_values("Pct_Increase_%").iloc[0]
print("\nLowest increase:")
print({"Fund": lowest["Fund"], "Ticker": lowest["Ticker"], "Pct_Increase_%": round(lowest["Pct_Increase_%"], 2)})
```
